lines.speaker: Ancient
lines.text: You have carried your question all this way.

lines.speaker: Character
lines.text: And found more than one answer.

lines.speaker: Ancient
lines.text: Then carry those answers beyond these walls.
Tu as porté ta question jusqu’ici.
Alors, porte ces réponses au-delà des murs.
答えは一つではありません。

lines.speaker: Character
lines.text: There is still another path to walk.
